page.content:
President and villain who wants to Krazy Glue the LEGO world in place.

How Lord Business connects

  • Work: The LEGO Movie — Lord Business is the suited antagonist of The LEGO Movie.
  • Character: Emmet Brickowski — Emmet and the Master Builders stand against Lord Business and the Kragle.

What is Lord Business?

Lord Business is the suited tyrant of The LEGO Movie who hoards the Kragle, forbids unofficial builds, and stands for the opposite of Godtfred's System: a world that can never be taken apart.

Key threads lead to The LEGO Movie and Emmet Brickowski.
